utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Oren can come by and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm he’s definitely coming?

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll keep the repair drive list organized and keep Bo posted on what we still need. Opal can note the main pickup spots and flag anything that needs a truck or extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, I’ll take the rest after Dane starts on the inventory list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara. Once Dane has the inventory list going, I’ll keep the repair drive list tidy and stay on top of what Bo still needs to know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think we still need to go over the full repair list, since Nell only had the loose hardware and door latches. Hana’s checking the total, so I’d rather make sure nothing’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, let’s make sure we’ve got every piece before we start. I’m helping, and I can bring an extra set of hands too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Right, let’s keep checking the full list with Hana before we start.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing. Jules can start calling folks now to round up a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep passing the word along, and after your errands we can check the roof patch and fence boards.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, I’ll be back after errands and can help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ira can check what’s left after errands, and Oren’s heading over to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, that should cover it for now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Last I heard, the porch screen and one gate latch were still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Right, then we’re just waiting on the porch screen and that latch. I’m keeping an eye on the updates until it’s all wrapped up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds right. I’ll keep listening for any new update on those two.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll keep an ear out for Rosa’s updates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can lend something from my shed for an hour or two if needed. Tess can point folks my way if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll let Rosa keep me posted and holler if I need that shed gear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I checked again, and we still need a little more for the repair drive. Leo can help, too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the rest and help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane. I’ll check the total one more time with Mina and let Leo know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got spare tarps and screws for the repair drive, and Sam can help too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the main pickup spots and flag whether any need a truck or extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the tarps and screws to the main pickup spot, and I’ll keep Sam in the loop if extra hands are needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school pickup, since that’s when I’m free.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think Cleo said she has tarps and some screws if we still need them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, then we should be set for the basics if Mara can be there at 4:30 too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m on it, Sam — I’ll tell a few neighbors and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll bring the drill and the screws, and I can help with the heavier lifting too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks — I’ll spread the word to a few more neighbors and see who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got spare tarps and screws for the repair drive, and Sam can help too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good to hear. Kira’s getting ready too, so it sounds like the drive’s coming together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing. Jules is calling folks now to round up a few more hands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll note the main pickup spots and flag which ones need a truck or extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that helps a lot — I’ll keep an eye on the truck spots while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think the full list is already with me, but if you want the exact total, I can go over it with you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard second-hand, but I thought the porch screen and one gate latch were still on the list. Could you check those against the full count?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can check that, but I’d rather not guess from second-hand details. If you want the exact count, I’ll go through the full repair list with you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help once I know what snag hit the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a few spare tools from my shed if that helps, and Tess can let folks know I have them on hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m on it — I’ll tell a few neighbors and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. Ira can check in after errands, and Oren’s coming by to help too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll spread the word to the neighbors and keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school pickup, and Mara already knows the drive starts at 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that keeps us on schedule. I’ll keep an eye on the updates and stick to the plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good. I’ll be there after pickup and keep an eye on the timing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’m on it — I’ll bring an extra set of hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ve got the drill and screws, and I can handle the heavier lifting when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll bring my extra hands and keep an eye out for Leo too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I checked again, and we still need a little more for the repair drive. Leo can help with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, then maybe Rey can cover the rest if Leo falls short.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, and if Leo still comes up short, Rey can step in for the rest.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the rest of the repair drive tasks and help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Dane. Keep me posted as things come in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll keep an eye out and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think Nell was asking about what's left on the list, and Cleo said she had tarps and screws if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, then we’re in good shape. I can spread the word and pull in a couple more hands if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds right. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear anything else needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the rest after Dane starts the inventory list, and Faye can help after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Oren can swing by and help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works too, as long as Faye still helps after pickup and Dane starts the inventory list first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is starting later than planned, right? I’m getting ready and can help once we start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it started later than planned, but we’re organized now. I’m keeping the list tidy, and I’ll let Bo know what we still need.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
